name: Angioedema (acute, non-hereditary)
advice: EMERGENCY if tongue/throat swelling, hoarse voice, breathing or swallowing difficulty, or faintness — go to casualty (adrenaline). Stop ACE-inhibitors (e.g. enalapril, ramipril) and avoid painkillers like aspirin/ibuprofen. If swelling recurs without hives, test C4 and C1-esterase inhibitor.
